FULL TEXT:
SHAHEED UDHAM SINGH
PANJAB UNIVERSITY CONSTITUENT COLLEGE
MOHAN KE HITHAR, GURU HAR SAHAI – FEROZEPUR
E. puccghs@gmail.com puccghs.org
. Dated: 12.06.2024
Advertisement for the Post of Peon
Applications are invited for One Post of Peon at Shaheed Udham Singh Panjab
University Constituent College, Guru Har Sahai, Ferozepur, on D.W. basis on current
D.C. Rate. The applications complete in all respect must reach in the office of the
Principal by 25.06.2024 (03.00 PM).
Name of the Post: Peon (01).
Age, Qualification and other Norms: As per Panjab University rules.
The venue and time of interview will be informed by post.
The candidates are required to submit the prescribed application form available at
https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php along with one set of photocopies of the
certificates.
No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending interview.
Dr. Sunil Khosla
Principal
